title: GOBAI-O2 Icechunk
description: GOBAI-O2 is a global, gridded (mapped) product of dissolved oxygen concentrations in the ocean, produced by applying machine learning methods to in-situ ocean profile observations (e.g., Argo floats and shipboard casts) and interpolating them onto a regular latitude/longitude/depth/time grid. This copy is distributed as an Icechunk-formatted Zarr store, archived by NOAA's National Centers for Environmental Information.
